picks.excerpt: Napster has relaunched with an AI-powered music app that licenses ethically trained, copyright-friendly generative models — positioning itself against streaming giants by promising artist-forward AI music creation. The company argues that the solution to music's AI permission problem is to build a platform that pays artists from the start.

A deep investigation reveals AI tools have quietly become standard in electronic music production at every level — from bedroom producers to headline acts who fear the backlash of admitting they use them. Artists describe a don't-ask, don't-tell culture emerging around AI assistance in the studio.
